task_instance: Generate a small synthetic dataset of customer product reviews (text, rating, product_category) using the Data Designer skill, following its documented workflow.
blocker_detail: SKILL.md explicitly instructs: 'Do not explore the workspace first. The workflow's Learn step gives you everything you need.' and directs the agent to read either workflows/interactive.md (Interactive mode) or workflows/autopilot.md (Autopilot mode) as the sole source of the actual step-by-step process, before doing anything else. Neither file exists next to SKILL.md (only SKILL.md and LICENSE are present in benchmark/ce_sources_ext/nvidia__skills__data-designer/; a Glob of the whole skill directory confirms no workflows/ or references/ subdirectory). references/seed-datasets.md and references/person-sampling.md, also referenced by the Rules section, are likewise missing. Without the workflow file, there is no defined procedure to follow (what questions to ask, how to scaffold the config, when/how to preview). Separately, even if the workflow were present, the skill's actual deliverable requires installing and running the `data-designer` Python library/CLI (per the Troubleshooting section) to build and preview the DataDesignerConfigBuilder output, which requires code execution unavailable in this office-assistant runtime (no shell/code execution, no package installation).
evidence: Read /home/user/skill-achievability-compiler/benchmark/ce_sources_ext/nvidia__skills__data-designer/SKILL.md in full. Attempted Read on workflows/interactive.md and workflows/autopilot.md -> both returned 'File does not exist'. Ran Glob('**/*') over the skill directory -> only SKILL.md and LICENSE listed, confirming no workflows/ or references/ subdirectories exist. No task files were created in the work directory since the workflow itself (the mandatory entry point per SKILL.md) could not be located.
